# Runtime dependencies for services/enrich (pinned; deps frozen per build contract).
# protobuf must match the major of the committed gencode in
# platform/proto/gen/python (generated by protobuf 7.35.1).
aiokafka==0.14.0
# cramjam backs aiokafka's snappy codec (aiokafka[snappy]); the Go producers
# (franz-go) snappy-compress batches by default, so consuming docs.chunked
# REQUIRES it — without it the worker dies with UnsupportedCodecError.
cramjam==2.9.1
httpx==0.28.1
protobuf==7.35.1
# --- M3 media pipeline (ADR-013) ---
# faster-whisper runs Whisper on CTranslate2 (NO torch) — CPU + int8 in dev/CI,
# keeping the image small enough for the constrained dev VM. CLIP is NOT here:
# it lives in the separate `clip` model service, called over HTTP. 1.2.1 declares
# its deps cleanly (1.1.1 imports `requests` without declaring it).
faster-whisper==1.2.1
# Pillow opens/resizes images for OCR input and thumbnails; pytesseract drives
# the `tesseract-ocr` binary (installed in the Dockerfile).
pillow==11.1.0
pytesseract==0.3.13
